title: Prince Harry, Elton John and Others Told to Pay Daily Mail Publisher $13 Million
summary_full: Harry and six other high-profile figures lost a privacy lawsuit against Associated Newspapers. They may eventually have to pay more than twice the initial sum, a judge said.
